rationale: Late stationary phase (44/48 h). Nitrogen is limiting; abundant amino acids (gln, asn, lys, thr, cys, pro) provide both carbon and nitrogen via deamination. Primary acetate uptake (6 mmol/gDW/h) + amino acid catabolism (2.8 mmol C/gDW/h combined) supports ~0.18 /h growth. Fermentation products (lactate, formate, CO₂, residual acetate) reflect Bifidobacterium homofermentative metabolism. Carbon and nitrogen budgets balance.
